services.desc: Discover the timeless beauty of the Schooner Hindu, a 1925 gaff-rigged schooner steeped in history and charm. This classic vessel has been lovingly restored to offer elegant and historically rich sailing experiences. Our sunset sails find a balance between being tranquil and rowdy. In light of this we do not have a youth price for our sunset sails, and discourage those with small children from riding with us for our evening sail. Sail Through History on our 1925 Gaff-Rigged Schooner and experience Key West’s most breathtaking sunset on the water. blurb: Guests sail aboard the historic Schooner Hindu or the Cutter Bloodhound in Cape Cod Bay. Experiences include sunset sails and day sails with opportunities to see wildlife and coastal scenery. The company is family-owned and focuses on preserving historic vessels and sharing their stories.
